processing: Videos re-encoded with ffmpeg to H.264 (yuv420p, 30 fps, 1-second keyframes), 720 px high, audio removed. Crops and trims are listed per item; content is otherwise unmodified.

items.title: Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 - EIC Version
items.dataCredit: Black Marble (Suomi NPP VIIRS). NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA GSFC.
items.notes: The only video on the page is 7680x2160 (32:9) and shows the world map about twice across its width. Cropped to one copy of the world (source columns 3719 to 7561, 3842 px = 360 degrees), so the left edge is 180 degrees longitude; the offset was measured by matching the land outline against the lightning map and is accurate to about a quarter of a degree. Trimmed to the first 21.8 s: the year series and the change map, ending before the zoomed insets.

items.title: Lightning Events Detected from the International Space Station (ISS) 2017-2023
items.notes: Science On a Sphere (flat equirectangular) version. Source is larger than 1080p; frame rate halved from 60 to 30 fps. labels.txt is NASA's date for each frame of the 60 fps source, stored here unmodified.
corrections: NASA's labels.txt gives the year as 2003 on its last 1,074 lines (after December 2022). The app displays these as 2023, because the dates are otherwise in order and the page describes data through 2023. The stored file is not edited.
